gold_review.explanation: answer_accuracy requires the whole reply to be exactly a JSON object {"answer": value} (numeric within 0.005, or exact string for region/category/id answers); our raw/boxed/xml variants aren't JSON so all score 0. String answers (Hardware/North/S0..) need quoting: {"answer": "{answer}"}.
